project.topic: What if you were the last man alive?
project.title: What if you were the last man alive?
project.audience: International, curious nontechnical viewers of science and space shorts (13+).
project.core_question: If every other male person vanished once, while women, pregnancies and stored sperm remained, what would actually happen to you and society?
project.viewer_takeaway: Sudden occupational losses create uneven emergencies. Existing pregnancies and preserved sperm mean humanity does not depend on one surviving man; newborn boys can appear immediately afterward.

audio.voice_style: Crisp, urgent, fascinated adult male; high-tension simulation narrator; brisk opening cadence
audio.music_direction: Original D-minor pulse, metallic urban tension, then warm suspended piano-like tones for the maternity reveal; return to the opening chord.
audio.sfx_direction: Crosswalk ambience, vanishing air rush, staggered driverless-car collisions, harbour machinery winding down, clinic footsteps, cold storage hiss; 0.3 seconds of -24 dB acoustic vacuum before the first collision.

scientific_model.baseline_reality: Modern Earth with highly uneven sex distributions across occupations. IMO-WISTA 2024 survey organisations employed approximately 1% women seafarers; WHO reports women as 67% of global health and social care workers. Frozen sperm is routinely used in fertility treatment.
scientific_model.counterfactual_change: At one instant every male person already born disappears except the adult male viewer. Women and girls remain. This is a one-time magical selection, not a repeating filter; no physical mechanism is claimed. Existing pregnancies, fetuses, embryos, stored gametes, objects, animals and infrastructure are unchanged.
assumptions: The viewer is an adult man and is the only exception to the disappearance.
The binary selection is an authored simplification for this thought experiment, not a medical or identity classification.
People disappear without explosive energy, mass-conversion heating, damage to the women beside them, or gravitational catastrophe.
Clothing worn by the vanished people disappears with them; separate carried objects and vehicles remain.
Pregnancies at all stages continue normally insofar as surviving healthcare and supplies allow. A birth already in progress can produce a boy moments afterward.
Cryopreserved sperm and embryos remain viable only with competent maintenance, supplies and appropriate consent; future treatment and recovery are not guaranteed.
Seconds, hours and days are separated by explicit HUD time labels. Recovery scenes depict one possible local response, not a worldwide forecast.
causal_chain: One-time removal of male people leaves the viewer and surviving women and girls.
Unattended moving vehicles continue through inertia and can crash; no automatic universal vehicle shutdown is assumed.
Occupations with high male representation face disproportionately severe staffing losses; shipping can stall as operations become unsafe.
Surviving professionals continue emergency care and coordinate local repairs despite loss, overload and supply disruption.
Existing pregnancies can immediately begin producing newborn boys after the event, without waiting nine months.
Preserved sperm and embryos retain genetic contributions from many other people if treatment infrastructure survives.
uncertainties: The selection event is fictional and has no scientific probability.
Reported occupation surveys use sex or gender categories that are only an approximate proxy for the fictional selection.
No global crash count, blackout deadline, political regime, reproductive coercion or universal social behaviour is predicted.
One surviving adult man remains the last adult man until boys mature, but is not necessarily the last male person for more than moments.
The long-term recovery and preserved gamete availability depend on local infrastructure; the film gives no extinction timetable.

claims.statement: Only one already-born male person remains immediately after the event; women and girls remain.
claims.reasoning: This is the stipulated one-time counterfactual, not an empirical prediction.
claims.presentation_guardrail: State the one-time rule in narration; do not imply a real disappearance mechanism.

claims.statement: Driverless moving vehicles can continue moving and collide.
claims.reasoning: Inertia preserves motion until forces change it; cars losing operators is a plausible accident trigger. Specific staged crashes are illustrative local events.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Show two local unbranded vehicle crashes without casualties or a numerical global estimate.

claims.statement: Shipping would face severe immediate crewing losses under the premise.
claims.reasoning: IMO-WISTA 2024 sample reported women at 1% of surveyed seafarers. Removing male people therefore implies exceptionally large staffing losses, with severity varying by ship.
claims.presentation_guardrail: The 1% figure is a survey baseline for women seafarers, not a measured post-event survivor rate or a census of port employees.

claims.statement: Women already provide most global health and social care labour.
claims.reasoning: WHO reports 67% of the global health and social care workforce as women. This does not mean every hospital keeps 67% of each specialty or supplies.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Narration says hospitals lose staff too. The statistic does not predict normal service after the shock.

claims.statement: A boy could be born moments after a one-time disappearance while the viewer remains the only adult man.
claims.reasoning: Pregnancies are unchanged by definition. A late-stage pregnancy or delivery already underway need not wait a new gestation interval.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Use could, not a fixed time or guaranteed birth. Newborn hand is a visual proxy; sex cannot be inferred from the hand.

claims.statement: Frozen sperm can preserve genetic contributions from other men for future fertility treatment if clinics keep operating.
claims.reasoning: HFEA documents cryoprotectant, liquid-nitrogen storage and clinical use of thawed sperm in IVF, IUI and ICSI. Continued local operation is conditional.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Do not imply storage alone guarantees births, indefinite supply, consent or recovery.

claims.statement: Local rebuilding can be performed by surviving trained women, with results depending on staff and supplies.
claims.reasoning: Women already work across healthcare, engineering and infrastructure. A local repair response is possible; its speed and global coverage are unknown.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Frame repair as a local response hours or days later, not an inevitable global outcome.

sources.name: IMO-WISTA Women in Maritime 2024 survey, published May 2025
WHO: Value gender and equity in the global health workforce

creative_direction.logline: Your crosswalk loses its men, your city loses critical workers, and the future turns out to be bigger than one survivor.
creative_direction.visual_identity: Premium full-frame 3D documentary: wet night street, NASA Earth, container port, active clinic, newborn hand macro and liquid-nitrogen storage. No charts or detached explanatory diagrams.
creative_direction.lighting: Cool blue environment with warm street practicals; physical area and key lighting, ACES grade, restrained HDR bloom; warm maternity finish.
creative_direction.camera_language: Opening y=1.68 m, 38 degree FOV, handheld sway 0.3. Orbit by 5.5 s. Continuous parallax or physical action every 2.5-4 seconds. Two numeric keyframes per shot.
creative_direction.motion_language: All gait, dissolves, traffic paths, collision kicks, crane stops, cloth breathing, finger curl and cryogenic vapour evaluate from absolute timestamps and seeds.
creative_direction.world_scale_policy: 1 unit = 1 metre in streets, port and clinic; Earth radius = 1 local planetary unit. No cross-scale object is presented as a literal metric comparison.
creative_direction.opening_hook: You're at a crossing when the men beside you vanish. The women stay.
creative_direction.mid_video_rehook: And here's the catch: humanity doesn't need you to father its entire future.
creative_direction.ending_payoff: The last adult man is not the sole genetic future: pregnancies continue and clinics hold preserved sperm.
creative_direction.loop_connection: Final spoken Remember where it started leads directly into opening You are at a crossing. A labelled memory rewind returns the final camera and crowd gait phase to frame zero.
creative_direction.asset_policy: Reuse actual registry components, including its documented CityStreetClassic implementation. Only story-specific cryostorage arrangement and traffic choreography are new.
